test_flush_memories_for_session: test the GatewayRunner._flush_memories_for_session method to verify memory flush behavior for a given session id
test_cron_session_bypass: test that GatewayRunner._flush_memories_for_session skips cron sessions and does not call session_store.load_transcript
test_memory_injection: test that memory file content from MEMORY.md and USER.md is injected into the flush agent prompt to prevent stale overwrites
test_flush_agent_silenced: test that the flush agent's _print_fn is set to a no-op so no terminal output leaks and resources are closed after the run
test_flush_prompt_structure: test that the flush prompt retains core instructions like 'automatically reset', 'Save any important facts', and 'Do NOT respond to the user'
